custody_model: Simple Earn operates inside Binance account infrastructure. Reviewed jurisdiction-specific disclosures show that legal treatment can vary and do not support one universal segregation, trust, ownership or creditor-right conclusion.
yield_source: Varies by product and jurisdiction. Binance presents flexible and locked Simple Earn separately from staking and Advanced Earn; reviewed disclosures include lending-related treatment for some Simple Earn assets. CYA does not infer one yield source across all assets and regions.
risk_notes: Risks include centralized-platform custody, lending/counterparty exposure, liquidity and redemption conditions, changing APRs, legal-entity and jurisdiction differences, and bankruptcy/segregation risk. Simple Earn must not be treated as a bank deposit or universal principal guarantee.

custody_model: Current Bitget terms state that Bitget acts as platform provider and that third parties may manage or custody underlying assets. The reviewed materials do not support one universal segregation, trust or customer-ownership conclusion across products and networks.
yield_source: Varies by product and underlying network. Historical Flexible Savings paid daily interest; current Simple Earn terms allow third-party and protocol-based asset management, while flexible and fixed variants have distinct reward and redemption mechanics.
risk_notes: Current terms identify Bitget credit and operational risk, third-party service-provider risk, protocol hacks/exploits/economic-model risk, possible loss of subscribed assets, variable rewards and lack of guaranteed principal return.
